intro: Fan Crown uses native rewards on Twitch and Kick, plus Viewer Foundation points on YouTube, TikTok and Facebook. Twitch keeps full reward mutation and refund support.

sections.title: 1. Connect each platform
sections.description: Paste Twitch and Kick reward IDs, then create the no-response Fan Crown command for YouTube, TikTok and Facebook.
sections.notice: Recommended rewards — Twitch: Fan Crown, base cost from this page, gold #F2C94C, description 'Claim the crown and become the stream current No. 1 Fan', Skip Reward Queue off. Kick: use the same title, description, color, and a fixed cost equal to Base cost. Kick captures are native, but Streamer.bot cannot automatically change the Kick title/cost or refund a rejected claim. YouTube, TikTok and Facebook spend the current displayed cost from Viewer Foundation.

sections.title: 2. Price progression
sections.description: Fixed increase is predictable. Multiplier is an advanced option. Every mode is rounded and stopped at the hard maximum.

sections.title: 3. Viewer rules and resets
sections.description: The current holder is blocked by default. Optional cooldowns use each platform account ID, not display names that can change.

sections.title: 4. Platform chat messages
sections.description: Capture announcements are editable. Refund explanations are disabled by default to avoid chat noise.

sections.title: 5. Crown overlay
sections.description: Use the add-on overlay URL shown by the wizard. Long names and leaderboard text are trimmed to fit the card.

sections.title: Maintenance and privacy
sections.description: The companion package includes Reset Crown and Reset Month actions. Attach them only to creator-controlled hotkeys or deck buttons.
sections.notice: Fan Crown stores only platform account IDs, current display names, optional HTTPS avatars, total points, claim counts, and a few timestamps in private saved data. It stores no chat text, OAuth token, SlothCoin balance, or hard-coded file path. Trigger tests and simulated reward events never change the real reward.
